title: [Correção] Deixar de apresentar erro e 403 como estado vazio no Manager
body:
## Problema e resultado esperado

Os carregadores de dados do Manager engolem o erro e devolvem lista vazia,
`null` ou objecto vazio. A pagina renderiza entao o estado de "sem registos" —
e diz ao utilizador que os dados nao existem, quando o que aconteceu foi que o
pedido falhou ou que ele nao tem permissao para os ver.

E o defeito nomeado na Issue #42: *erros tecnicos apresentados como estados
vazios ou sucesso*. A auditoria de 2026-08-20 apanhou-o em `/viaturas/{id}`;
o padrao esta em 17 pontos de 14 ficheiros.

Resultado esperado: uma recusa e uma falha nunca podem ser indistinguiveis de
"nao ha nada". `403` mostra estado *forbidden*, erro mostra estado de erro com
accao, e a lista vazia continua a ser lista vazia.

### Inventario confirmado em 2026-08-22

| Ficheiro | Ocorrencias |
| --- | --- |
| `app/lib/workshop-api.ts` | 3 (linhas 266, 308, 348) |
| `app/lib/drivers-api.ts` | 2 (43, 92) |
| `app/lib/billing-api.ts` | 1 (196) |
| `app/lib/clients-api.ts` | 1 (37) |
| `app/lib/contracts-api.ts` | 1 (42) |
| `app/lib/control-tower-api.ts` | 1 (346) |
| `app/lib/hr-api.ts` | 1 (65) |
| `app/lib/known-routes-api.ts` | 1 (29) |
| `app/lib/payables-api.ts` | 1 (28) |
| `app/lib/trip-orders-api.ts` | 1 (37) |
| `app/lib/trips-api.ts` | 1 (64) |
| `app/lib/vehicles-api.ts` | 1 (37) |
| `app/lib/auth.ts` | 1 (113) |
| `app/lib/auth-refresh.ts` | 1 (42) |

`loadPayrollSlips` em `hr-api.ts` ja foi corrigido na PR #44 e serve de
referencia: devolve um resultado discriminado `ok | forbidden | error` e a
pagina rende `ForbiddenState` ou estado de erro. Os restantes 17 seguem o
mesmo desenho.

Os dois casos em `auth.ts` e `auth-refresh.ts` sao diferentes e precisam de
leitura propria: devolver `null` numa falha de sessao pode ser o
comportamento correcto, mas tem de ser deliberado e comentado.

## Escopo e fora de escopo

### Escopo

1. Tipo de resultado discriminado por carregador, no molde de
   `PayrollSlipsResult`.
2. `ForbiddenState` (`app/components/ui/ForbiddenState.tsx`) em cada superficie
   que possa receber 403, dizendo que papel tem acesso.
3. Estado de erro distinto do vazio, com mensagem accionavel e sem texto
   tecnico ao utilizador.
4. Teste por carregador a provar as quatro saidas: dados, lista vazia, 403 e
   erro tecnico. A lista vazia continuar a ser lista vazia e parte do contrato.
5. Regra de lint ou teste de arquitectura que impeca `catch { return [] }`
   novo em `app/lib/`.

### Fora de escopo

- Redesenho visual das paginas para la dos estados em falta.
- Alteracoes ao backend; os codigos de erro ja sao suficientes.

## Criterios de aceite

- [ ] Nenhum carregador em `app/lib/` converte erro ou 403 em coleccao vazia.
- [ ] Cada rota de release distingue, de forma visivel, dados / vazio /
      forbidden / erro.
- [ ] Testes provam as quatro saidas por carregador.
- [ ] Um utilizador `viewer` que abra uma superficie restrita ve a que papel
      pertence o acesso, e nao "nenhum registo".
- [ ] Gate impede a reintroducao do padrao.

## UX, acessibilidade e motion

`ForbiddenState` usa `role="status"`; o estado de erro usa `role="alert"`. Sem
salto de layout entre skeleton e estado final. Texto sempre em portugues, sem
codigos nem stack traces. `prefers-reduced-motion` respeitado nas transicoes.

## Observabilidade

Contagem de 403 por rota do Manager, para distinguir configuracao errada de
papel de uso legitimo. Erros tecnicos continuam a ir para a consola do
servidor com `correlation_id`, nunca para o ecra.

## Arquitectura, qualidade e testes

`tsc --noEmit` limpo, Vitest por carregador, e Playwright a cobrir pelo menos
uma jornada com papel sem permissao.

## Deploy, verificacao e rollback

Sem migracao. O risco e de apresentacao: uma pagina que hoje mostra "sem
registos" passara a mostrar recusa ou erro, o que pode expor falhas ate agora
silenciosas — esse e o objectivo, mas convem avisar o suporte antes do deploy.

Rollback e o deploy do SHA anterior.

title: [Correção] Ligar as 8 permissões declaradas que não protegem nenhuma rota
body:
## Problema e resultado esperado

Auditoria sistematica de `backend/app/core/rbac.py` contra os guardas reais
(`require_permission` / `require_platform_role`) a 2026-08-22: das 53
permissoes declaradas, 41 protegem rotas, 3 (`PLATFORM_*`) usam o guarda de
plataforma e estao correctas, e **8 nao protegem endpoint nenhum**.

Uma permissao que nenhum endpoint exige nao restringe nada, mas faz a politica
parecer mais apertada do que e: os papeis sao concedidos ou negados em
`ROLE_PERMISSIONS`, quem revê raciocina sobre isso, e a superficie que devia
proteger esta guardada por uma permissao mais larga que mais papeis ja tem.

Resultado esperado: cada permissao declarada protege pelo menos uma rota, ou
deixa de existir.

`HR_SALARY_VIEW` era a nona e ja foi corrigida na PR #44 por expor salario
liquido e NIB bancario a `viewer`. As 8 restantes ficam aqui.

### Estado confirmado

| Permissao | Papeis que a politica lhe da | O endpoint exige | Quem ganha acesso nao previsto |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workshop.quote_approve` | admin, manager, owner | `workshop.write` | **mechanic, receptionist** |
| `workshop.reception` | receptionist e outros | `workshop.write` | **mechanic** |
| `workshop.quote` | admin, manager, owner, receptionist | `workshop.write` | mechanic |
| `cargo.validate_delivery` | admin, manager, owner | `cargo.write` | — (mesmos papeis) |
| `accounting.reverse` | owner | nenhuma rota o exige | a definir |
| `payables.approve` | admin, owner | nenhuma rota o exige | a definir |
| `admin.tenant` | owner | guardado por escopo | a definir |
| `workshop.release_vehicle` | — | rota inexistente | — |

Dois casos merecem leitura propria:

- **`workshop.quote_approve`**: aprovar um orcamento e o acto que autoriza
  custo ao cliente. Estar ao alcance de qualquer `workshop.write` significa
  que o mecanico que estima o trabalho tambem o aprova.
- **`cargo.validate_delivery`**: validar, disputar e resolver disputa de prova
  de entrega estao em `CARGO_WRITE`. Mesmo sem alargar papeis, perde-se a
  segregacao de funcoes: quem regista a entrega valida-a. A permissao existe
  precisamente para separar as duas maos.

## Escopo e fora de escopo

### Escopo

1. Ligar `workshop.quote_approve` a aprovacao de orcamento e `workshop.quote`
   a criacao, em `workshop/quote_router.py`.
2. Ligar `workshop.reception` aos endpoints de recepcao de viatura.
3. Ligar `cargo.validate_delivery` a validate/dispute/resolve-dispute de prova
   de entrega, mantendo `CARGO_WRITE` na criacao.
4. Decidir, por permissao, o destino de `accounting.reverse`,
   `payables.approve` e `admin.tenant`: ligar a rota, ou remover de rbac.py.
   Uma permissao sem uso previsto nao deve ficar declarada.
5. `workshop.release_vehicle` acompanha a criacao do endpoint de libertacao;
   fica bloqueada nesta Issue ate esse endpoint existir.
6. Remover de `UNENFORCED_ON_PURPOSE` em
   `backend/tests/test_rbac_permission_coverage.py` cada entrada fechada. O
   teste `test_recorded_debt_is_still_real` ja falha se a entrada ficar la.

### Fora de escopo

- Redesenho do modelo de papeis ou introducao de papeis novos.
- Permissoes de plataforma, que usam `require_platform_role` e estao correctas.

## Criterios de aceite

- [ ] `test_no_new_permission_is_declared_without_gating_a_route` passa com
      `UNENFORCED_ON_PURPOSE` reduzido a `WORKSHOP_RELEASE`, ou vazio.
- [ ] Matriz por papel prova que mechanic e receptionist recebem 403 com
      `error.code == "forbidden"` ao aprovar orcamento, e que admin, manager e
      owner continuam a conseguir.
- [ ] Recepcao de viatura recusa mechanic e aceita receptionist.
- [ ] Validacao de prova de entrega exige `cargo.validate_delivery`; a criacao
      continua em `cargo.write`, com teste a provar que os dois actos exigem
      permissoes diferentes.
- [ ] Nenhuma permissao declarada em rbac.py fica sem rota nem sem decisao
      registada.
- [ ] Zero regressao: suite backend verde e `verify:api-contracts` a 0.

## UX, acessibilidade e motion

As superficies afectadas passam a poder devolver 403 a papeis que hoje entram.
Cada uma precisa de estado `forbidden` explicito, distinto de vazio e de erro,
com texto que diga qual o papel necessario — e nao mensagem tecnica. O botao
de aprovar orcamento deve estar desactivado com explicacao para quem nao pode
aprovar, em vez de falhar so depois do clique. Sem alteracao de layout ao
mudar de estado; `prefers-reduced-motion` respeitado.

## Observabilidade

Contagem de 403 por permissao e por rota, para medir quem perde acesso apos o
deploy e distinguir recusa legitima de configuracao errada de papel. Sem
identificadores pessoais nos atributos.

## Arquitectura, qualidade e testes

- Ruff e Pyright limpos.
- Extensao das matrizes existentes: `test_rbac_matrix.py` para criacao e
  `test_rbac_transitions_matrix.py` para transicoes, ambas derivadas de
  `ROLE_PERMISSIONS`.
- Teste dedicado a segregacao de funcoes na prova de entrega.
- `test_rbac_permission_coverage.py` como gate final.

## Deploy, verificacao e rollback

Aditivo em termos de dados; a alteracao e de autorizacao. O risco e
operacional, nao de integridade: papeis que hoje trabalham podem ficar
bloqueados. Deploy em staging com dois tenants, verificando com um utilizador
real de cada papel afectado antes de producao.

Rollback e o deploy do SHA anterior, sem migracao a reverter. Se um papel
ficar bloqueado indevidamente, a correccao e conceder a permissao em
`ROLE_PERMISSIONS`, nao reabrir o guarda do endpoint.

title: feat(convergencia): fechar contratos HTTP Manager/Driver/backend e eliminar falso sucesso
body:

Closes #42

Linha canónica C0-C4 de convergência Manager, Driver e backend, publicada até

- backend C2: `1010/1010`, Ruff, Pyright e OpenAPI verdes numa base descartável
  migrada até `rec16`;
- contratos C3/PR18 após remediação: `18/18` e Ruff focado verde;

- Driver: `67/67`, typecheck, build PWA e Playwright mobile `7/7` na baseline
  C2;
- Redmi físico: pairing, update, cold start offline, reconciliação, documentos,
  terminal read-only e refresh `401 -> 200 -> 200` no produto `a978229`;
- Node `20.20.2`/npm `10.8.2`: auditorias produção/completa com zero

## Risco, segurança e dados

- mutações offline validam identidade física, ownership, lifecycle e
  idempotência sem partilha entre motoristas/dispositivos;

- migrations seguem expansão compatível; forward-fix/rollback exige snapshot,

- não repetir os runs atuais antes de regularizar a conta GitHub.

- [x] Implementação local diferenciada de certificação runtime.
- [x] Evidência Android identificada pelo produto/artefacto testado.

title: [Melhoria] Fechar convergência Cliente↔Terceiro no modelo de entidades externas
body:
## Problema e resultado esperado

O modelo ERP correcto e ja parcialmente implementado no ROTAS: `third_parties` e a
entidade externa mestre e `client_profiles` e o papel comercial. `clients/service.py`
faz find-or-create de `ThirdParty` por `(tenant_id, nuit)`, garante
`ThirdPartyRole(role_type="client")` e cria `ClientProfile` antes de inserir `Client`.

A convergencia, porem, nao esta fechada: o papel continua a carregar os dados-mestre e
a ser o alvo de FK da facturacao. Resultado esperado: uma unica entidade externa por
NUIT e por tenant, com papeis, sem atributos mestre nem termos comerciais duplicados,
e sem a mesma entidade a aparecer duas vezes nas superficies de pesquisa.

### Divergencias confirmadas em 2026-08-21

1. **O papel carrega os dados-mestre.** `clients` mantem `trading_name`, `nuit`,
   `address`, `phone`, `email` proprios (`backend/app/modules/clients/models.py:22-52`)
   e e `clients.id` — nao `third_parties.id` — o alvo de FK em `contracts.client_id`,
   `billing_documents.client_id` e `client_payments.client_id`.
2. **Dupla fonte de verdade comercial.** `clients.payment_terms_days` e
   `clients.credit_limit` coexistem com `client_profiles.payment_terms_days` e
   `client_profiles.credit_limit` (`backend/app/modules/third_party/models.py:377-378`).
   Nada impede divergencia entre as duas.
3. **O papel `client` e ilegal na API publica.** `VALID_ROLE_TYPES`
   (`backend/app/modules/third_party/schemas.py:105`) nao inclui `client` e
   `POST /api/v1/third-party/{tp_id}/roles` rejeita-o com 422, enquanto o modulo de
   clientes o escreve internamente. O mesmo papel e criado por uma via e recusado pela outra.
4. **Duplicacao no directorio.** `search_party_directory`
   (`backend/app/modules/third_party/service.py:721-766`) faz `UNION ALL` de `drivers`,
   `clients` e `third_parties` como `subject_type` distintos, pelo que a mesma entidade
   real surge como `client` e como `third_party`.

## Escopo e fora de escopo

### Escopo

1. Adoptar `client` em `VALID_ROLE_TYPES` e alinhar validacao, RBAC e testes.
2. Desduplicar `party-directory`: uma linha por entidade real, com os papeis como
   atributo, preservando `subject_type` para compatibilidade de leitura.
3. Migrar `contracts`, `billing_documents` e `client_payments` para `third_party_id`
   por widen-migrate-narrow: nova coluna a par do `client_id` existente, backfill por
   `clients.third_party_id` (ja populado), corte das leituras, so entao remocao.
4. Tornar `client_profiles` dono exclusivo de termos de pagamento, limite de credito,
   moeda preferida e email de facturacao; reduzir `Client` a projeccao de leitura.
5. Ler nome, NUIT, morada e contactos a partir de `third_parties`.

### Fora de escopo

- Alterar o contrato HTTP publico de `/api/v1/clients` nesta Issue; a compatibilidade
  de resposta e mantida enquanto a projeccao existir.
- Fusao de entidades duplicadas pre-existentes com NUIT divergente (Issue separada).
- Modelo `Pessoa` vs `Organizacao` acima de `Terceiro`.

## Criterios de aceite

- [ ] `POST /api/v1/third-party/{tp_id}/roles` aceita `client` e o papel criado pelo
      modulo de clientes e indistinguivel do criado pela API.
- [ ] Uma entidade com NUIT unico aparece exactamente uma vez em `party-directory`,
      com todos os seus papeis, provado com entidade que e simultaneamente cliente e
      fornecedor.
- [ ] `contracts`, `billing_documents` e `client_payments` resolvem a entidade por
      `third_party_id`, com backfill a 100% e zero linhas orfas.
- [ ] Termos comerciais tem uma unica fonte de verdade; teste prova que a alteracao em
      `client_profiles` e a lida pela facturacao.
- [ ] Isolamento multitenant preservado: RLS activa nas colunas novas e tentativa real
      tenant A -> B rejeitada com a role restrita da aplicacao.
- [ ] Zero regressao de contrato: `verify:api-contracts` e o teste de OpenAPI mantem-se
      verdes; `/api/v1/clients` devolve o mesmo shape.
- [ ] Faturacao historica reconciliada: totais AR por cliente identicos antes e depois
      do backfill.

## UX, acessibilidade e motion

Pesquisa de entidade (`party-directory`, selectores de cliente em contrato, ordem e
facturacao) precisa de skeleton inicial, estado vazio distinto de erro, estado
forbidden para quem nao tem `FLEET_READ`, e estado parcial quando so parte dos papeis
carrega. O resultado passa a mostrar os papeis como badges com ponto colorido conforme
DESIGN.md. Sem alteracao de layout durante a resolucao da pesquisa; transicoes abaixo
de 300 ms, apenas `transform`/`opacity`, com caminho equivalente sob
`prefers-reduced-motion`.

## Observabilidade

Span por resolucao de entidade com atributos `tenant_id`, `subject_type` e contagem de
papeis — nunca NUIT, nome ou contactos. Metrica de contagem de linhas por backfill e
alerta sobre orfaos (`client_id` sem `third_party_id` correspondente) durante a janela
de coexistencia. Erros de migracao para Sentry com `correlation_id` do request.

## Arquitectura, qualidade e testes

- Ruff e Pyright no backend; sem `type: ignore` novo em `clients/service.py`.
- Unitario: resolucao de papeis, precedencia de termos comerciais, validacao de `client`.
- Integracao: criacao de cliente que reutiliza terceiro existente por NUIT; entidade
  com dois papeis; cross-tenant A -> B; replay idempotente da criacao.
- Migracao: upgrade sobre base vazia e sobre snapshot com dados historicos, com
  verificacao de invariantes fisicos, nao apenas do rotulo de revisao.
- E2E Playwright: contrato -> ordem -> factura sobre entidade com duplo papel.
- Coverage sem regressao; mutation testing nos modulos `clients` e `third_party`.

## Deploy, verificacao e rollback

Faseado. Fase 1 (aditiva, reversivel): `client` em `VALID_ROLE_TYPES`, desduplicacao do
directorio, colunas novas + backfill, dupla escrita. Fase 2: corte das leituras para
`third_party_id`. Fase 3: remocao de `client_id` e dos atributos duplicados, so apos
uma janela de observacao limpa. Cada fase e um PR proprio com o seu deploy.

Rollback: as fases 1 e 2 revertem-se por deploy do SHA anterior, sem perda de dados,
porque `client_id` permanece populado ate a fase 3. A fase 3 exige snapshot restore
testado e so avanca com evidencia de zero leituras do FK antigo em producao.

`PRODUCTION_RELEASE_LEDGER` mantem NO-GO ate a fase 2 estar verde em staging com dois
tenants.

title: [Correção] Fechar convergência ponta a ponta entre Manager, Driver e backend
body:
## Problema

A auditoria ponta a ponta de 2026-08-20 confirmou que o Manager renderiza várias superfícies, mas não existe casamento completo e executável entre frontend, BFF e backend. Há endpoints inexistentes, respostas não verificadas e erros técnicos apresentados como estados vazios ou sucesso. A PWA Driver não arranca na toolchain local Node 24 e precisa de reprodução no Node 20 suportado.

## Evidência confirmada

- `/viaturas/{id}` chama `/api/v1/checklists/checklists` e recebe 405; a UI mostra falsamente “Nenhuma checklist registada”.
- `/api/v1/accounting/manual-entry`, `/api/v1/fuel/purchases`, `/api/v1/payables/orders` e `/api/v1/governance/cases` devolvem 404 no backend real.
- criação/transição/notas de tarefas não validam sistematicamente `Response.ok`; a UI pode navegar como se tivesse concluído.
- Oficina expõe mensagens técnicas em inglês e `[object Object]`.
- os gates estáticos atuais não validam path+method+schema OpenAPI, tratamento de erro, estados obrigatórios ou uniformidade visual integral.
- Manager: 43 rotas estáticas verificadas em desktop e 360 px; estrutura sem overflow global, mas com lacunas semânticas e funcionais.
- Driver: testes unitários existentes verdes, porém dev/build não reproduzíveis no ambiente atual Node 24; repetir em Node 20 limpo e no RC.

## Escopo

1. Corrigir os cinco contratos HTTP confirmados ou remover/bloquear superfícies sem backend aprovado.
2. Tornar toda mutação fail-closed: `res.ok`, erro tipado, feedback acionável e sem redirecionamento de falso sucesso.
3. Diferenciar loading, empty, error, forbidden, partial/degraded em todas as rotas de release.
4. Gerar/validar inventário frontend path+method+request+response contra OpenAPI e contratos externos aprovados.
5. Recanonicalizar componentes/tokens/landmarks e eliminar mensagens técnicas ao utilizador.
6. Certificar jornadas verticais reais Manager e Driver, desktop/mobile, dois tenants, offline→online.
7. Reproduzir Driver em Node 20 e fixar a toolchain do RC.

O ROTAS possui gates técnicos e práticas úteis, mas ainda não tem um contrato transversal que obrigue qualquer agente ou contributor a iniciar toda correção, melhoria ou nova função numa Issue, executar por PR e promover apenas um SHA revisto. Também falta uma definição única que una UX assíncrona/motion, observabilidade, arquitectura, lint, testes e coverage sem confundir implementação local com certificação runtime.

## Escopo

- Tornar `CLAUDE.md` a porta de entrada obrigatória para agentes.
- Consolidar o contrato em `docs/ENGINEERING_STANDARDS.md`.
- Criar formulário de Issue e template de PR.
- Criar gate que exige `Closes #<número>` e secções de evidência/deploy.
- Registar o estado real de Sentry, Prometheus/Grafana/Alertmanager, OpenTelemetry, Datadog/New Relic, lint, architecture contracts, testes, coverage e mutation testing.
- Aplicar Design Motion Principles com Emil Kowalski primário e Jakub Krehel secundário para o dashboard SaaS ROTAS.

## Fora de escopo

- Activar serviços pagos ou agentes Datadog/New Relic.
- Implementar de uma vez todos os gaps técnicos listados.
- Declarar produção certificada com base apenas no checkout local.

## Critérios de aceite

- [ ] Toda tarefa futura começa numa Issue classificada como Correção, Melhoria ou Nova função.
- [ ] Todo PR contém `Closes #<número>`, evidência reproduzível, risco, deploy e rollback.
- [ ] Deploy promove somente merge/release SHA imutável.
- [ ] Todo agente encontra o padrão a partir de `CLAUDE.md`.
- [ ] UX assíncrona cobre skeleton/loading, pending/progresso, empty, partial/degraded, error/forbidden e success quando aplicável.
- [ ] Lazy loading não introduz CLS nem remove foco/erro/confirmação.
- [ ] Motion passa frequency gate, usa propriedades performantes e suporta `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- [ ] Observabilidade define OpenTelemetry como contrato vendor-neutral e Sentry como error/performance.
- [ ] Ferramentas ausentes são marcadas como pendentes, não como implementadas.
- [ ] YAML, Markdown, simulação do gate e `git diff --check` passam.

## Observabilidade e segurança

Nenhum payload, token, cookie, salário, dado médico, documento, coordenada precisa ou identificador humano/tenant cru pode entrar na telemetria. Certificação exige ambiente, SHA e jornada.

## Deploy e rollback

Mudança documental e de GitHub governance. Rollout: merge do PR, activar o novo check na branch protection e testar um PR válido/inválido. Rollback: reverter o merge e retirar temporariamente o check requerido, preservando a Issue e a auditoria.

# PR12 — Produtores críticos ligados ao transactional outbox

Data: 2026-08-09

Branch: `codex/pr12-outbox-producers`

Base: `0b43265` (`codex/pr11-unit-of-work`)

## Resultado

Estado: **done_local para os critérios próprios do PR12**; **não certificado
para release**.

O produtor central de exceções operacionais deixou de executar envio HTTP
fire-and-forget com `asyncio.create_task`. Exceções `high` e `critical` agora
persistem uma linha tenant-scoped no transactional outbox, na mesma sessão e
transação que a exceção, o alerta e os registos de audit. A entrega de rede fica
exclusivamente a cargo do worker após o commit.

Esse produtor é usado pelos fluxos críticos de carga, combustível, viagens,
oficina e checklists. Exceções `low` e `medium` permanecem internas e não criam
evento externo.

## Contrato do produtor

- `OutboxEvent.id` reutiliza o identificador da exceção para dar identidade
  determinística ao evento.
- `tenant_id`, `aggregate_type=operational_exception`, `aggregate_id` e
  `event_type` são persistidos com o payload.
- UUIDs e datas do payload são convertidos para JSON antes da gravação em
  `JSONB`.
- Uma repetição sequencial de `ensure_exception` devolve a exceção ativa e não
  cria outro evento.
- Rollback do chamador remove conjuntamente exceção, alerta, audit e outbox.
- Eventos de tenants diferentes permanecem identificados e isolados pelo seu
  `tenant_id`, inclusive quando referenciam o mesmo identificador operacional.

## Gate contra regressão

Um teste AST percorre `backend/app/**/*.py` e falha se encontrar:

- qualquer chamada `create_task(...)` ou `asyncio.create_task(...)`;
- import direto de `app.modules.governance.client` por um produtor.

O cliente legado permanece disponível dentro do módulo Governance, mas não
possui callsites no backend operacional. Novos produtores precisam entrar pelo
outbox.

## Limites preservados

- Nenhum ficheiro de billing foi alterado.
- O PR12 não muda o endpoint, autenticação ou schema usado para entregar ao
  Governance; essa correção pertence ao PR13.
- Retry, DLQ, alertas operacionais, reconciliação e replay pertencem ao PR14.
- Não foram adicionados produtores internos de faturação nem alterações ao
  domínio fiscal.

| Suite backend integral | 564 passed, 1 skipped |
| Pyright `pyright-ci.json` | 0 erros, 0 avisos |

title: PR-11: atomic unit of work for critical mutations

# PR11 — Unit of Work por caso de uso crítico

Data: 2026-08-09

Branch: `codex/pr11-unit-of-work`

Base: `40c3a58` (`codex/pr10-http-contract`)

## Resultado

Estado: **done_local para os critérios próprios do PR11**; **não certificado
para release**.

A fronteira HTTP idempotente passou a ser uma unidade transacional única. A
reserva da chave, a mutação de negócio, audit, movimentos contabilísticos,
eventual linha de outbox e resposta persistida são confirmados em conjunto. Se
o caso de uso falhar, todos os efeitos dessa sessão são revertidos, incluindo
`commit()` legado chamado por serviços internos. Sessões auxiliares continuam
independentes e não são capturadas pela fronteira.

O pagamento a fornecedor é a implementação vertical de referência: bloqueia a
fatura com `FOR UPDATE`, calcula o saldo confirmado, impede sobrepagamento,
valida as contas antes da mutação e grava pagamento, estado da fatura, diário,
audit e resposta idempotente na mesma transação.

## Contratos e isolamento

- `Idempotency-Key` é obrigatório em
  `POST /api/v1/payables/invoices/{invoice_id}/pay`.
- A repetição com a mesma chave e payload devolve a resposta original sem criar
  outro pagamento, diário ou audit.
- Duas chaves concorrentes para a mesma fatura são serializadas pelo lock: uma
  liquidação integral confirma e a outra recebe HTTP 409.
- Uma falha após um `commit()` interno reverte mutação, audit, outbox e reserva
  idempotente; um commit executado numa sessão auxiliar permanece confirmado.
- O contrato OpenAPI e o cliente Manager foram regenerados para refletir o
  header obrigatório.

## Limites preservados

- Nenhum ficheiro em `backend/app/modules/billing/` foi alterado; billing
  permaneceu funcionalmente congelado.
- O PR11 prova que uma linha de outbox participa atomicamente na unidade de
  trabalho, mas não liga novos produtores. Essa integração permanece no PR12.
- Retry, DLQ, reconciliação e operação do outbox permanecem nos PRs 12–14.

body:
Bumps [undici](https://github.com/nodejs/undici) from 7.28.0 to 7.29.0.
Release notes

Sourced from undici's releases.

v7.29.0

⚠️ Security fixes

High severity

  • GHSA-4cwx-7wf7-3272: malformed qualified private Cache-Control directives could cause cross-user information disclosure in shared caches or a parse-time crash. The cache parser now treats empty qualified directives conservatively and safely handles mixed qualified and unqualified directives. Fixed by 9f10f1e9, with regression coverage in 466e99d1.

Medium severity

  • GHSA-m8rv-5g2x-5cg5: a malicious type property on a duck-typed blob-like HTTP/1.1 request body could inject CRLF sequences into the generated content-type header. Undici now coerces and validates the value before adding it to the request. Fixed by 33928bc2.
  • GHSA-jr45-8vmc-qm54: optional whitespace around = in qualified no-cache and private directives could bypass shared-cache restrictions and disclose authenticated data across users. Cache-Control parsing now normalizes these forms and applies conservative cache decisions. Fixed by 98011a86.
  • GHSA-8xcm-r25x-g524: the retry interceptor could expose a stale Content-Length after resuming a partial response, potentially causing downstream response desynchronization, hangs, or corruption. Undici now rejects partial responses whose Content-Length is inconsistent with Content-Range. Fixed by 1b5a5312, with corrected fixtures in 4a9dafb1.
  • GHSA-v3r7-h72x-cjcm: unsanitized domain and unparsed values passed to setCookie() could inject cookie attributes. Undici now validates cookie domains, paths, and unparsed attributes more strictly. Fixed by 3bf91ddb.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/nodejs/undici/compare/v7.28.0...v7.29.0

body:
Bumps [node-forge](https://github.com/digitalbazaar/forge) to 1.3.2 and updates ancestor dependency [react-scripts](https://github.com/facebook/create-react-app/tree/HEAD/packages/react-scripts). These dependencies need to be updated together. Updates `node-forge` from 0.9.0 to 1.3.2
Changelog

Sourced from node-forge's changelog.

1.3.2 - 2025-11-25

Security

  • HIGH: ASN.1 Validator Desynchronization
    • An Interpretation Conflict (CWE-436) vulnerability in node-forge versions 1.3.1 and below enables remote, unauthenticated attackers to craft ASN.1 structures to desynchronize schema validations, yielding a semantic divergence that may bypass downstream cryptographic verifications and security decisions.
    • Reported by Hunter Wodzenski.
    • CVE ID: CVE-2025-12816
    • GHSA ID: GHSA-5gfm-wpxj-wjgq
  • HIGH: ASN.1 Unbounded Recursion
    • An Uncontrolled Recursion (CWE-674) vulnerability in node-forge versions 1.3.1 and below enables remote, unauthenticated attackers to craft deep ASN.1 structures that trigger unbounded recursive parsing. This leads to a Denial-of-Service (DoS) via stack exhaustion when parsing untrusted DER inputs.
    • Reported by Hunter Wodzenski.
    • CVE ID: CVE-2025-66031
    • GHSA ID: GHSA-554w-wpv2-vw27
  • MODERATE: ASN.1 OID Integer Truncation
    • An Integer Overflow (CWE-190) vulnerability in node-forge versions 1.3.1 and below enables remote, unauthenticated attackers to craft ASN.1 structures containing OIDs with oversized arcs. These arcs may be decoded as smaller, trusted OIDs due to 32-bit bitwise truncation, enabling the bypass of downstream OID-based security decisions.

Changelog

[3.14.2] - 2025-11-15

Security

  • Backported v4.1.1 fix to v3

[4.1.1] - 2025-11-12

Security

  • Fix prototype pollution issue in yaml merge (<<) operator.

[4.1.0] - 2021-04-15

Added

  • Types are now exported as yaml.types.XXX.
  • Every type now has options property with original arguments kept as they were (see yaml.types.int.options as an example).

Changed

  • Schema.extend() now keeps old type order in case of conflicts (e.g. Schema.extend([ a, b, c ]).extend([ b, a, d ]) is now ordered as abcd instead of cbad).

[4.0.0] - 2021-01-03

Changed

  • Check migration guide to see details for all breaking changes.
  • Breaking: "unsafe" tags !!js/function, !!js/regexp, !!js/undefined are moved to js-yaml-js-types package.
  • Breaking: removed safe* functions. Use load, loadAll, dump instead which are all now safe by default.
  • yaml.DEFAULT_SAFE_SCHEMA and yaml.DEFAULT_FULL_SCHEMA are removed, use yaml.DEFAULT_SCHEMA instead.
  • yaml.Schema.create(schema, tags) is removed, use schema.extend(tags) instead.
  • !!binary now always mapped to Uint8Array on load.
  • Reduced nesting of /lib folder.
  • Parse numbers according to YAML 1.2 instead of YAML 1.1 (01234 is now decimal, 0o1234 is octal, 1:23 is parsed as string instead of base60).
  • dump() no longer quotes :, [, ], (, ) except when necessary, #470, #557.
  • Line and column in exceptions are now formatted as (X:Y) instead of at line X, column Y (also present in compact format), #332.
  • Code snippet created in exceptions now contains multiple lines with line numbers.
  • dump() now serializes undefined as null in collections and removes keys with undefined in mappings, #571.
  • dump() with skipInvalid=true now serializes invalid items in collections as null.
  • Custom tags starting with ! are now dumped as !tag instead of !<!tag>, #576.
  • Custom tags starting with tag:yaml.org,2002: are now shorthanded using !!, #258.

Added

  • Added .mjs (es modules) support.
  • Added quotingType and forceQuotes options for dumper to configure string literal style, #290, #529.
  • Added styles: { '!!null': 'empty' } option for dumper (serializes { foo: null } as "foo: "), #570.

body:
Bumps [axios](https://github.com/axios/axios) from 1.16.0 to 1.18.0.
Release notes

Sourced from axios's releases.

v1.18.0 — June 13, 2026

This release hardens redirect and URL handling, improves the validateStatus configuration semantics, and includes updates to documentation, dependencies, and release metadata.

🔒 Security Fixes

  • Redirect Header Safety: Added Node HTTP adapter support for stripping caller-specified sensitive headers on cross-origin redirects, helping prevent custom auth headers such as API keys from leaking to another origin. (#10892)

  • URL And Request Hardening: Rejects malformed http: and https: URLs that omit // with ERR_INVALID_URL, while tightening prototype-pollution-safe config reads, stream size limits, FormData depth handling, data URL sizing, and local NO_PROXY matching. (#11000)

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Status Validation: Added transitional.validateStatusUndefinedResolves so applications can opt in to treating validateStatus: undefined like the option was omitted, while validateStatus: null remains the explicit way to accept every status. (#10899)

🔧 Maintenance & Chores

  • Documentation: Published the v1.17.0 release notes, fixed a changelog typo, clarified the package update PR policy, and marked the proxy request config as Node.js-only in the advanced docs. (#10984, #10988, #10992, #10995)

  • Dependencies: Bumped @babel/core, @babel/preset-env, @commitlint/cli, @commitlint/config-conventional, @rollup/plugin-babel, @rollup/plugin-commonjs, @vitest/browser, @vitest/browser-playwright, eslint, lint-staged, rollup, vitest, and actions/checkout. (#10989, #10996, #10997)

title: Refactor: Modernize styling workflow with Sass, BEM, and script minification
body:
**Description:**

The goal of this issue is to migrate the project from a basic static setup to a modular development environment. This will improve maintainability through Sass features, ensure CSS scalability using BEM, and optimize production performance by minifying assets with Terser.

**Action Plan / Checklist**

**1. Environment & Tooling Setup**

- [x] Initialize npm (npm init -y).

- [x] Install dev dependencies: sass and terser.

- [x] Configure build scripts in package.json for automation.

**2. Directory Restructuring**

- [x] Create src/ directory for source code (development).

- [x] Create public/ (or dist/) directory for compiled assets (distribution).

- [x] Move HTML, images, and other assets to the new structure.

- [x] Update HTML <link> and <script> tags to point to the build folder.

**3. Sass Architecture (1-7 Pattern & Modules)**

- [x] Set up the 1-7 pattern folder structure (e.g., abstracts/, base/, components/, layout/).

- [x] Create a centralizing index file (e.g., _index.scss) using @forward for all partials.

- [x] Configure main.scss to consume the architecture via @use.

**4. Code Migration & Refactoring**

- [x] **Variables**: Migrate colors and fonts to abstracts/_variables.scss.

- [x] **Gradual Migration**: Move CSS styles into their respective Sass partials.

- [ ] **Chore**: UI and logic cleanup.

- [ ] **BEM Methodology**: Refactor CSS classes to follow BEM naming convention (block__element--modifier).

- [x] **JS Optimization**: Set up Terser to minify JavaScript files into the public/ folder.

**5. Deployment & Finalization**

- [ ] Verify if the site renders correctly from the public/ directory.

- [ ] Reconfigure GitHub Pages to point to the new deployment directory.

**Technical Notes:**

- This migration will use the modern Sass Module System (@use and @forward) instead of the deprecated @import.

- Zero visual regression is expected; the layout must remain identical after the refactor.

5.2.0

  • added session usage
  • made the public http_cache service handle requests when available
  • allowed enabling trusted hosts and proxies using new kernel.trusted_hosts, kernel.trusted_proxies and kernel.trusted_headers parameters
  • content of request parameter _password is now also hidden in the request profiler raw content section

5.1.0

  • allowed to use a specific logger channel for deprecations
  • made WarmableInterface::warmUp() return a list of classes or files to preload on PHP 7.4+; not returning an array is deprecated

  • deprecated support for service:action syntax to reference controllers, use serviceOrFqcn::method instead

  • added session usage reporting when the _stateless attribute of the request is set to true
  • added AbstractSessionListener::onSessionUsage() to report when the session is used while a request is stateless

5.0.0

  • removed support for getting the container from a non-booted kernel
  • removed the first and second constructor argument of ConfigDataCollector

title: CVE-2007-4559 Patch
body:
# Patching CVE-2007-4559

Hi, we are security researchers from the Advanced Research Center at [Trellix](https://www.trellix.com). We have began a campaign to patch a widespread bug named CVE-2007-4559. CVE-2007-4559 is a 15 year old bug in the Python tarfile package. By using extract() or extractall() on a tarfile object without sanitizing input, a maliciously crafted .tar file could perform a directory path traversal attack. We found at least one unsantized extractall() in your codebase and are providing a patch for you via pull request. The patch essentially checks to see if all tarfile members will be extracted safely and throws an exception otherwise. We encourage you to use this patch or your own solution to secure against CVE-2007-4559. Further technical information about the vulnerability can be found in this [blog](https://www.trellix.com/en-us/about/newsroom/stories/research/tarfile-exploiting-the-world.html).

If you have further questions you may contact us through this projects lead researcher [Kasimir Schulz](mailto:kasimir.schulz@trellix.com).

Bumps [node-forge](https://github.com/digitalbazaar/forge) to 1.3.2 and updates ancestor dependency [react-scripts](https://github.com/facebook/create-react-app/tree/HEAD/packages/react-scripts). These dependencies need to be updated together. Updates `node-forge` from 0.9.0 to 1.3.2
Changelog

Sourced from node-forge's changelog.

1.3.2 - 2025-11-25

Security

  • HIGH: ASN.1 Validator Desynchronization
    • An Interpretation Conflict (CWE-436) vulnerability in node-forge versions 1.3.1 and below enables remote, unauthenticated attackers to craft ASN.1 structures to desynchronize schema validations, yielding a semantic divergence that may bypass downstream cryptographic verifications and security decisions.
    • Reported by Hunter Wodzenski.
    • CVE ID: CVE-2025-12816
    • GHSA ID: GHSA-5gfm-wpxj-wjgq
  • HIGH: ASN.1 Unbounded Recursion
    • An Uncontrolled Recursion (CWE-674) vulnerability in node-forge versions 1.3.1 and below enables remote, unauthenticated attackers to craft deep ASN.1 structures that trigger unbounded recursive parsing. This leads to a Denial-of-Service (DoS) via stack exhaustion when parsing untrusted DER inputs.
    • Reported by Hunter Wodzenski.
    • CVE ID: CVE-2025-66031
    • GHSA ID: GHSA-554w-wpv2-vw27
  • MODERATE: ASN.1 OID Integer Truncation
    • An Integer Overflow (CWE-190) vulnerability in node-forge versions 1.3.1 and below enables remote, unauthenticated attackers to craft ASN.1 structures containing OIDs with oversized arcs. These arcs may be decoded as smaller, trusted OIDs due to 32-bit bitwise truncation, enabling the bypass of downstream OID-based security decisions.
    • Reported by Hunter Wodzenski.
    • CVE ID: CVE-2025-66030
    • GHSA ID: GHSA-65ch-62r8-g69g

Fixed

  • [asn1] Fix for vulnerability identified by CVE-2025-12816 PKCS#12 MAC verification bypass due to missing macData enforcement and improper asn1.validate routine.
  • [asn1] Add fromDer() max recursion depth check.
    • Add a asn1.maxDepth global configurable maximum depth of 256.
    • Add a asn1.fromDer() per-call maxDepth option.
    • NOTE: The default maximum is assumed to be higher than needed for valid data. If this assumption is false then this could be a breaking change. Please file an issue if there are use cases that need a higher maximum.
    • NOTE: The per-call maxDepth parameter has not been exposed up through all of the API stack due to the complexities involved. Please file an issue if there are use cases that require this instead of changing the default maximum.
  • [asn1] Improve OID handling.
    • Error on parsed OID values larger than 2**32 - 1.
    • Error on DER OID values larger than 2**53 - 1 .

  • Schema.extend() now keeps old type order in case of conflicts (e.g. Schema.extend([ a, b, c ]).extend([ b, a, d ]) is now ordered as abcd instead of cbad).

[4.0.0] - 2021-01-03

Changed

  • Check migration guide to see details for all breaking changes.
  • Breaking: "unsafe" tags !!js/function, !!js/regexp, !!js/undefined are moved to js-yaml-js-types package.
  • Breaking: removed safe* functions. Use load, loadAll, dump instead which are all now safe by default.
  • yaml.DEFAULT_SAFE_SCHEMA and yaml.DEFAULT_FULL_SCHEMA are removed, use yaml.DEFAULT_SCHEMA instead.
  • yaml.Schema.create(schema, tags) is removed, use schema.extend(tags) instead.
  • !!binary now always mapped to Uint8Array on load.
  • Reduced nesting of /lib folder.
  • Parse numbers according to YAML 1.2 instead of YAML 1.1 (01234 is now decimal, 0o1234 is octal, 1:23 is parsed as string instead of base60).
  • dump() no longer quotes :, [, ], (, ) except when necessary, #470, #557.
  • Line and column in exceptions are now formatted as (X:Y) instead of at line X, column Y (also present in compact format), #332.
  • Code snippet created in exceptions now contains multiple lines with line numbers.
  • dump() now serializes undefined as null in collections and removes keys with undefined in mappings, #571.
  • dump() with skipInvalid=true now serializes invalid items in collections as null.
  • Custom tags starting with ! are now dumped as !tag instead of !<!tag>, #576.
  • Custom tags starting with tag:yaml.org,2002: are now shorthanded using !!, #258.

Added

  • Added .mjs (es modules) support.
  • Added quotingType and forceQuotes options for dumper to configure string literal style, #290, #529.
  • Added styles: { '!!null': 'empty' } option for dumper (serializes { foo: null } as "foo: "), #570.

v7 What's new

Direct Uploads

Adds support for uploading single files directly (unzipped). Callers can set the new archive parameter to false to skip zipping the file during upload. Right now, we only support single files. If  we turn on the swipe 
```
otslider.init({
...
swipe: true,
...});
```

 
then vertical swipe stops working: it is impossible to scroll up/down by touching the image
**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to demo page https://iniohd.github.io/otslider.html
2. Touch the first image and try to scroll up/down and nothing happens, but if we touch outside of the image, then it works.

turning on swipe should not affect the ability to scroll the page on the phone/tablet.

title: Namespace is not recognized in the generator
body:
Hi, hope you are doing well.
I just came across with your package and wanted to give it a try, it looks nice.

When running the generator it's returning the message "Class does not exist" for all my classes, and printing the class name without the namespace. I debugged the code and I found that the token_get_all function is returning the namespace token as 265 instead of 262(T_STRING). After doing some investigation I found this [https://github.com/squizlabs/PHP_CodeSniffer/issues/3041](https://github.com/squizlabs/PHP_CodeSniffer/issues/3041). In my case (I'm running PHP 8.2) changing T_STRING for T_NAME_QUALIFIED fixed the issue.

Cheers

These dependencies need to be updated together. Updates `debug` from 2.6.8 to 2.6.9
Release notes

Sourced from debug's releases.

Huge thanks to @​zhuangya for their help!

body:
Bumps [qs](https://github.com/ljharb/qs) to 6.4.1 and updates ancestor dependencies [qs](https://github.com/ljharb/qs), [body-parser](https://github.com/expressjs/body-parser), [express](https://github.com/expressjs/express), [grunt-contrib-less](https://github.com/gruntjs/grunt-contrib-less) and [grunt-contrib-watch](https://github.com/gruntjs/grunt-contrib-watch). These dependencies need to be updated together. Updates `qs` from 6.4.0 to 6.4.1
Changelog

Sourced from qs's changelog.

6.4.1

  • [Fix] parse: ignore __proto__ keys (#428)
  • [Fix] fix for an impossible situation: when the formatter is called with a non-string value
  • [Fix] use safer-buffer instead of Buffer constructor
  • [Fix] utils.merge: avoid a crash with a null target and an array source
  • [Fix] utils.merge`: avoid a crash with a null target and a truthy non-array source
  • [Fix] stringify: fix a crash with strictNullHandling and a custom filter/serializeDate (#279)
  • [Fix] utils: merge: fix crash when source is a truthy primitive & no options are provided
  • [Fix] when parseArrays is false, properly handle keys ending in []
  • [Robustness] stringify: avoid relying on a global undefined (#427)
  • [Refactor] use cached Array.isArray
  • [Refactor] stringify: Avoid arr = arr.concat(...), push to the existing instance (#269)
  • [readme] remove travis badge; add github actions/codecov badges; update URLs
  • [Docs] Clarify the need for "arrayLimit" option
  • [meta] fix README.md (#399)
  • [meta] Clean up license text so it’s properly detected as BSD-3-Clause
  • [meta] add FUNDING.yml
  • [actions] backport actions from main
  • [Tests] remove nonexistent tape option
  • [Dev Deps] backport from main

title: Bump phpmailer/phpmailer from 5.2.22 to 6.5.0
body:
Bumps [phpmailer/phpmailer](https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer) from 5.2.22 to 6.5.0.
Release notes

Sourced from phpmailer/phpmailer's releases.

PHPMailer 6.5.0

This is a security release.

  • SECURITY Fixes CVE-2021-34551, a complex RCE affecting Windows hosts. See https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/blob/HEAD/SECURITY.md for details.
  • The fix for this issue changes the way that language files are loaded. While they remain in the same PHP-like format, they are processed as plain text, and any code in them will not be run, including operations such as concatenation using the . operator.
  • Deprecation The current translation file format using PHP arrays is now deprecated; the next major version will introduce a new format.
  • SECURITY Fixes CVE-2021-3603 that may permit untrusted code to be run from an address validator. See https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/blob/HEAD/SECURITY.md for details.
  • The fix for this issue includes a minor BC break: callables injected into validateAddress, or indirectly through the $validator class property, may no longer be simple strings. If you want to inject your own validator, provide a closure instead of a function name.
  • Haraka message ID strings are now recognised

Thanks to Vikrant Singh Chauhan, listensec.com, and the WordPress security team for reporting and assistance with this release.

PHPMailer 6.4.1

This is a security release.

  • SECURITY Fixes CVE-2020-36326, a regression of CVE-2018-19296 object injection introduced in 6.1.8, see SECURITY.md for details
  • Reject more file paths that look like URLs, matching RFC3986 spec, blocking URLS using schemes such as ssh2
  • Ensure method signature consistency in doCallback calls
  • Ukrainian language update
  • Add composer scripts for checking coding standards and running tests

Thanks to Fariskhi Vidyan for the report and assistance, and Tidelift for support.

PHPMailer 6.4.0

This is a maintenance release. The changes introduced in 6.3.0 for setting an envelope sender automatically when using mail() caused problems, especially in WordPress, so this change has been reverted. It gets a minor version bump as it's a change in behaviour, but only back to what 6.2.0 did. See #2298 for more info.

Other changes:

  • Check for the mbstring extension before decoding addresss in parseAddress, so it won't fail if you don't have it installed
  • Add Serbian Latin translation (sr_latn)
  • Enrol PHPMailer in Tidelift, because supporting open-source is important!

PHPMailer 6.3.0

This is a maintenance release.

  • Handle early connection errors such as 421 during connection and EHLO states
  • Switch to Github Actions for CI
  • Generate debug output for mail(), sendmail, and qmail transports. Enable using the same mechanism as for SMTP: set SMTPDebug > 0
  • Make the mail() and sendmail transports set the envelope sender the same way as SMTP does, i.e. use whatever From is set to, only falling back to the sendmail_from php.ini setting if From is unset. This avoids errors from the mail() function if Sender is not set explicitly and php.ini is not configured. This is a minor functionality change, so bumps the minor version number.
  • Extend parseAddresses to decode encoded names, improve tests

PHPMailer 6.2.0

This is a maintenance release. With this release, PHPMailer gains official PHP 8 compatibility; earlier versions worked in PHP 8 pre-releases, but the test suite did not. The considerable rework this required (which also restored tests running on older PHP versions) was done by @​jrfnl – thank you very much!

  • PHP 8.0 compatibility
  • Switch from PHP CS Fixer to PHP CodeSniffer for coding standards
  • Create class constants for the debug levels in the POP3 class
  • Improve French, Slovenian, and Ukrainian translations
  • Improve file upload examples so file extensions are retained
  • Resolve PHP 8 line break issues due to a very old PHP bug being fixed

... (truncated)

Release notes

Sourced from engine.io's releases.

6.2.1

:warning: This release contains an important security fix :warning:

A malicious client could send a specially crafted HTTP request, triggering an uncaught exception and killing the Node.js process:

Error: read ECONNRESET
    at TCP.onStreamRead (internal/stream_base_commons.js:209:20)
Emitted 'error' event on Socket instance at:
    at emitErrorNT (internal/streams/destroy.js:106:8)
    at emitErrorCloseNT (internal/streams/destroy.js:74:3)
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:80:21) {
  errno: -104,
  code: 'ECONNRESET',
  syscall: 'read'
}

Please upgrade as soon as possible.

Bug Fixes

  • catch errors when destroying invalid upgrades (#658) (425e833)

6.2.0

Features

  • add the "maxPayload" field in the handshake details (088dcb4)

So that clients in HTTP long-polling can decide how many packets they have to send to stay under the maxHttpBufferSize value.

This is a backward compatible change which should not mandate a new major revision of the protocol (we stay in v4), as we only add a field in the JSON-encoded handshake data:

0{"sid":"lv_VI97HAXpY6yYWAAAC","upgrades":["websocket"],"pingInterval":25000,"pingTimeout":5000,"maxPayload":1000000}

  • analytics APIs have been removed without replacement from @angular-devkit/core and @angular-devkit/architect.

  • TypeScript versions older than 4.8.2 are no longer supported.

v3.9.1 2022-04-06

  • Fix recursive definition of InputFileFormat introduced in 3.9.0.

  • Update types JSZip#loadAsync to accept a promise for data, and remove arguments from new JSZip() (see #752)
  • Update types for compressionOptions to JSZipFileOptions and JSZipGeneratorOptions (see #722)
  • Add types for generateInternalStream (see #774)

v3.8.0 2022-03-30

  • Santize filenames when files are loaded with loadAsync, to avoid "zip slip" attacks. The original filename is available on each zip entry as unsafeOriginalName. See the documentation. Many thanks to McCaulay Hudson for reporting.

v3.7.1 2021-08-05

  • Fix build of dist files.
    • Note: this version ensures the changes from 3.7.0 are actually included in the dist files. Thanks to Evan W for reporting.

v3.7.0 2021-07-23

  • Fix: Use a null prototype object for this.files (see #766)
    • This change might break existing code if it uses prototype methods on the .files property of a zip object, for example zip.files.toString(). This approach is taken to prevent files in the zip overriding object methods that would exist on a normal object.

Bumps [jsdom](https://github.com/jsdom/jsdom) from 19.0.0 to 21.0.0.
Release notes

Sourced from jsdom's releases.

Version 21.0.0

A potentially-breaking bug fix:

  • Fixed the window, document, location, and top properties of Window to be non-configurable. (ExE-Boss)

Other changes:

  • Added support for <input type=image> submitting forms. (jenseng)
  • Added the location setter to the Window object, which forwards to the location.href setter. Setting the URL is still only implemented for fragment navigations, however. (ExE-Boss)
  • Fixed defer="" <script> elements that are added after DOMContentLoaded to execute, instead of being skipped.
  • Fixed selectElement.selectedOptions being incorrect when optionElement.selected is set. This was a regression introduced in v20.0.1. Unfortunately this also reverts the performance improvement when appending <option> elements that was introduced then. (eps1lon)
  • Fixed the self, locationbar, menubar, personalbar, scrollbars, statusbar, toolbar, frames, parent, external, length, and screen properties of Window to be replaceable: that is, setting them will override their values, instead of having the new value be ignored. (ExE-Boss)
  • Fixed a few issues with JSOM.fromURL() in the browser build of jsdom. (LungZeno)

Version 20.0.3

  • Updated dependencies, notably w3c-xmlserializer, which fixes using DOMParser on XML documents containing emoji.

Version 20.0.2

  • Fixed xhr.abort() to no longer give an exception when the constructed XMLHttpRequest was invalid. (whamtet)
  • Fixed event.getModifierState() on MouseEvent and KeyboardEvent instances to properly consult the ctrlKey, altKey, metaKey, and shiftKey properties of the event. (juzerzarif)
  • Fixed custom element creation to not be affected by any modifications to the window.customElements property. (bicknellr)

  • Fixed crypto.getRandomValues() to accept typed array subclasses. (sebamarynissen)
  • Updated various dependency minor versions. Notably, nwsapi fixed some selectors bugs, and tough-cookie fixed some cookie bugs.

create an element that has `height: 100vh` style as the first element inside the `body` tag to be rendered as cover

title: Bump phpmailer/phpmailer from 5.2.27 to 6.5.0
body:
Bumps [phpmailer/phpmailer](https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer) from 5.2.27 to 6.5.0.
Release notes

Sourced from phpmailer/phpmailer's releases.

PHPMailer 6.5.0

This is a security release.

  • SECURITY Fixes CVE-2021-34551, a complex RCE affecting Windows hosts. See https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/blob/HEAD/SECURITY.md for details.
  • The fix for this issue changes the way that language files are loaded. While they remain in the same PHP-like format, they are processed as plain text, and any code in them will not be run, including operations such as concatenation using the . operator.
  • Deprecation The current translation file format using PHP arrays is now deprecated; the next major version will introduce a new format.
  • SECURITY Fixes CVE-2021-3603 that may permit untrusted code to be run from an address validator. See https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/blob/HEAD/SECURITY.md for details.
  • The fix for this issue includes a minor BC break: callables injected into validateAddress, or indirectly through the $validator class property, may no longer be simple strings. If you want to inject your own validator, provide a closure instead of a function name.
  • Haraka message ID strings are now recognised

Thanks to Vikrant Singh Chauhan, listensec.com, and the WordPress security team for reporting and assistance with this release.

PHPMailer 6.4.1

This is a security release.

  • SECURITY Fixes CVE-2020-36326, a regression of CVE-2018-19296 object injection introduced in 6.1.8, see SECURITY.md for details
  • Reject more file paths that look like URLs, matching RFC3986 spec, blocking URLS using schemes such as ssh2
  • Ensure method signature consistency in doCallback calls
  • Ukrainian language update
  • Add composer scripts for checking coding standards and running tests

Thanks to Fariskhi Vidyan for the report and assistance, and Tidelift for support.

PHPMailer 6.4.0

This is a maintenance release. The changes introduced in 6.3.0 for setting an envelope sender automatically when using mail() caused problems, especially in WordPress, so this change has been reverted. It gets a minor version bump as it's a change in behaviour, but only back to what 6.2.0 did. See #2298 for more info.

Other changes:

  • Check for the mbstring extension before decoding addresss in parseAddress, so it won't fail if you don't have it installed
  • Add Serbian Latin translation (sr_latn)
  • Enrol PHPMailer in Tidelift, because supporting open-source is important!

PHPMailer 6.3.0

This is a maintenance release.

  • Handle early connection errors such as 421 during connection and EHLO states
  • Switch to Github Actions for CI
  • Generate debug output for mail(), sendmail, and qmail transports. Enable using the same mechanism as for SMTP: set SMTPDebug > 0
  • Make the mail() and sendmail transports set the envelope sender the same way as SMTP does, i.e. use whatever From is set to, only falling back to the sendmail_from php.ini setting if From is unset. This avoids errors from the mail() function if Sender is not set explicitly and php.ini is not configured. This is a minor functionality change, so bumps the minor version number.
  • Extend parseAddresses to decode encoded names, improve tests

PHPMailer 6.2.0

This is a maintenance release. With this release, PHPMailer gains official PHP 8 compatibility; earlier versions worked in PHP 8 pre-releases, but the test suite did not. The considerable rework this required (which also restored tests running on older PHP versions) was done by @​jrfnl – thank you very much!

  • PHP 8.0 compatibility
  • Switch from PHP CS Fixer to PHP CodeSniffer for coding standards
  • Create class constants for the debug levels in the POP3 class
  • Improve French, Slovenian, and Ukrainian translations
  • Improve file upload examples so file extensions are retained
  • Resolve PHP 8 line break issues due to a very old PHP bug being fixed

... (truncated)

Changelog

  • SECURITY Fixes CVE-2021-34551, a complex RCE affecting Windows hosts. See https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/blob/master/SECURITY.md for details.
  • The fix for this issue changes the way that language files are loaded. While they remain in the same PHP-like format, they are processed as plain text, and any code in them will not be run, including operations such as concatenation using the . operator.
  • Deprecation The current translation file format using PHP arrays is now deprecated; the next major version will introduce a new format.
  • SECURITY Fixes CVE-2021-3603 that may permit untrusted code to be run from an address validator. See https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/blob/master/SECURITY.md for details.
  • The fix for this issue includes a minor BC break: callables injected into validateAddress, or indirectly through the $validator class property, may no longer be simple strings. If you want to inject your own validator, provide a closure instead of a function name.
  • Haraka message ID strings are now recognised

Version 6.4.1 (April 29th, 2021)

  • SECURITY Fixes CVE-2020-36326, a regression of CVE-2018-19296 object injection introduced in 6.1.8, see SECURITY.md for details
  • Reject more file paths that look like URLs, matching RFC3986 spec, blocking URLS using schemes such as ssh2
  • Ensure method signature consistency in doCallback calls
  • Ukrainian language update
  • Add composer scripts for checking coding standards and running tests

Version 6.4.0 (March 31st, 2021)

  • Revert change that made the mail() and sendmail transports set the envelope sender if one isn't explicitly provided, as it causes problems described in PHPMailer/PHPMailer#2298
  • Check for mbstring extension before decoding addresss in parseAddress
  • Add Serbian Latin translation (sr_latn)
  • Enrol PHPMailer in Tidelift

  • Switch to Github Actions for CI

  • Improve French, Slovenian, and Ukrainian translations

title: Implement the lang parameter (PT/EN)
body:
## Context
The `lang` query param is parsed and echoed back in the JSON response, but it doesn't do anything yet — all rendered text is hard-coded Portuguese (the narrative line, labels, and the empty state).

## What's wanted
Make `lang` actually switch the rendered language, supporting at least `pt` (default) and `en`:
- Translate the narrative sentence, any labels, and the empty-state text.
- **Correct pluralization in each language** — this is the part that's easy to get wrong. Portuguese and English pluralize differently, and `n=0`/`n=1` edge cases matter (`1 push` / `2 pushes`, `1 issue` / `2 issues`, and their PT equivalents).

## Where to start
`src/lib.js` already has `pluralize(n, singular, plural)` and `buildNarrative({ days, stats, topRepositories })`. Generalize those to take a language (or a small message table) rather than hard-coding Portuguese strings. All of it is pure and unit-tested with no network — add EN cases alongside the existing PT tests in `test/lib.test.js`.

## Honest constraints
- Keep wording honest across languages: still pushes/issues, never "commits"/"contributions".
- Scope is PT + EN; don't over-engineer a full i18n framework unless a contributor wants to.

title: Render more event types (releases, reviews, stars, comments)
body:
## Context
`aggregate` in `src/lib.js` currently counts `PushEvent`, `PullRequestEvent`, and `IssuesEvent`, and ignores the rest. The GitHub events API exposes more types that would make both the JSON output and the (planned) activity feed richer — closer to the variety [jamesgeorge007/github-activity-readme](https://github.com/jamesgeorge007/github-activity-readme) shows.

## What's wanted
Recognize and surface more event types in both `format=json` and the activity feed, for example:
- `ReleaseEvent` — published a release
- `PullRequestReviewEvent` / `PullRequestReviewCommentEvent` — reviewed a PR
- `WatchEvent` — starred a repo
- `IssueCommentEvent` / `CommitCommentEvent` — commented

Each new type needs: a count in the aggregation, an icon + phrasing for the feed line, and unit tests (the test suite is network-free — add fixture events to `test/lib.test.js`).

## Honest constraints
- Keep the wording honest and specific to what each event actually represents. `WatchEvent` means a star was given, not received — don't imply otherwise.
- The ~300-event API ceiling still applies; rarer event types may simply not appear in the window for some users.
- This is a good first issue: the pattern to follow already exists in `aggregate`'s `switch` statement.

title: Add response caching to survive README embed traffic
body:
## Context
An embedded card is fetched **every time someone views the README** that embeds it. Each of those requests currently triggers a fresh paginated crawl of the GitHub events API. Without caching, a card on any moderately-viewed README will burn through the GitHub API rate limit (60/hr unauthenticated, 5,000/hr with a token) fast.

## What's wanted
Cache responses so repeated views don't re-hit GitHub on every request:
- Use the Cloudflare [Cache API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/cache/) (or equivalent) keyed by the request URL (username + days + theme + format).
- Apply a short TTL (e.g. a few minutes) — long enough to absorb embed traffic, short enough that activity stays reasonably fresh.
- Set sensible `Cache-Control` headers on the response.

## Honest constraints
- **Camo interaction.** GitHub serves README images through its Camo image proxy, which caches them on its own. A contributor should understand that GitHub's cache sits in front of ours, so the effective freshness is a combination of both — our TTL is not the only thing in play.
- Caching trades freshness for rate-limit survival; the TTL choice is a deliberate balance, not a bug.

title: Deploy the Worker so the SVG is embeddable via a real URL
body:
## Context
The project is local-dev only — it runs via `npm run dev` (Wrangler) and has never been deployed. There is no live URL. That's the single biggest blocker to the whole point of the project: **without a deployed URL, nobody can actually embed the card in a README.**

## What's wanted
Deploy the Worker to Cloudflare and document the result:
- Deploy via `wrangler deploy` to a Cloudflare account.
- Set the GitHub token as a real secret with `wrangler secret put GITHUB_TOKEN` — **never** commit it. The local `.dev.vars` flow stays as-is for development; production uses the Wrangler secret store.
- Document the resulting public URL and an embed example (e.g. `![activity](https://<worker-url>/?username=<you>&format=svg)`) in the README.

## Honest constraints
- A deployed public endpoint will receive uncontrolled traffic; pair this with response caching (see the caching issue) before publicizing the URL, or the GitHub API rate limit will be hit quickly.
- Whoever deploys needs their own Cloudflare account; this issue is about making deployment work and documenting it, not standing up an official hosted instance.

title: Multi-line SVG that visually matches a text activity feed
body:
## Context
Today the SVG card (`format=svg`) shows a single aggregated narrative line — *"Nos últimos 90 dias: 142 pushes e 3 issues em 3 repositórios."* — on a fixed 495×195 card. The flagship direction for this project is different: render a **vertical list of recent activities**, one per line, so the card looks visually identical to [jamesgeorge007/github-activity-readme](https://github.com/jamesgeorge007/github-activity-readme)'s output — but served as an **SVG image over a plain URL**, with no GitHub Action and nothing written back into the README.

## What's wanted
An SVG that renders one line per recent event, each with an icon + description + repo. For example:
- `🎉 Merged PR #12 in owner/repo`
- `💪 Opened issue #8 in owner/repo`
- `🔨 Pushed to owner/repo`

The aggregation logic already classifies events in `src/lib.js` (`aggregate`); this is mostly a new pure renderer (alongside `renderCard`) plus the per-event line mapping, all unit-testable with no network.

## Honest trade-offs a contributor must handle
- **Variable height.** The card can no longer be a fixed 195px — height must grow with N lines. The `viewBox`/`height` need to be computed from the line count.
- **Per-line truncation.** Long descriptions and `owner/repo` names must be truncated per line so they can't overflow the card width. There's an existing `truncate` helper to reuse/extend.
- **A max-lines cap.** Pick a sensible ceiling (e.g. 5–10 lines) so the card stays embeddable and predictable.
- **It's an image, not markdown.** Unlike the Action's text version, links won't be clickable and text won't be selectable. That's an inherent cost of the SVG-over-URL approach and should be accepted, not hidden.
- **API ceiling.** GitHub serves at most ~300 public events per user, so the feed reflects that window, not full history.
- **Honest wording.** Keep counting pushes, not commits — the public events API no longer exposes per-push commit counts. Don't relabel pushes as commits.

  • expose EnableWasmLoadingPlugin

  • add Tree Shaking support for ProvidePlugin

Bumps [bootstrap](https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap) from 4.1.1 to 4.3.1.
Release notes

Sourced from bootstrap's releases.

v4.3.1

  • Security: Fixed an XSS vulnerability (CVE-2019-8331) in our tooltip and popover plugins by implementing a new HTML sanitizer
  • Fixed a small issue with our RFS (responsive font sizes) mixins

v4.3.0

Highlights

  • New: Added .stretched-link utility to make any anchor the size of it's nearest position: relative parent, perfect for entirely clickable cards!
  • New: Added .text-break utility for applying word-break: break-word
  • New: Added .rounded-sm and .rounded-lg for small and large border-radius.
  • New: Added .modal-dialog-scrollable modifier class for scrolling content within a modal.
  • New: Added responsive .list-group-horizontal modifier classes for displaying list groups as a horizontal row.
  • Improved: Reduced our compiled CSS by using null for variables that by default inherit their values from other elements (e.g., $headings-color was inherit and is now null until you modifier it in your custom CSS).
  • Improved: Badge focus styles now match their background-color like our buttons.
  • Fixed: Silenced bad selectors in our JS plugins for the href HTML attribute to avoid JavaScript errors. Please try to use valid selectors or the data-target HTML attribute/target option where available.
  • Fixed: Reverted v4.2.1's change to the breakpoint and grid container Sass maps that blocked folks from upgrading when modifying those default variables.
  • Fixed: Restored white-space: nowrap to .dropdown-toggle (before v4.2.1 it was on all .btns) so carets don't wrap to new lines.
  • Deprecated: img-retina, invisible, float, and size mixins are now deprecated and will be removed in v5.

Links

  • Read the full ship list
  • Review the project board

v4.2.1

Bump to v4.2.1 to republish package on npm. See v4.2.0 release notes for changes introduced in v4.2.

v4.2.0

Here are the highlights of what's new and updated in v4.2.

  • New: Added a new spinner loading component.
  • New: Added new toast component for displaying notifications.
  • New: Added a new iOS style switch (a modifier class to our custom checkboxes).
  • New: Added touch support in our carousel component.
  • New: Added .font-weight-lighter and .font-weight-bolder utilities.
  • New: Added .text-decoration-none utility class.
  • New: Added .modal-xl modifier class for our modals.
  • New: Added new negative margin utility classes (e.g., .mb-n3). These rad new classes not only allow you more control over your general spacing needs, but also allow you to create responsive grid gutters at each breakpoint.
  • New: Validated form fields now have feedback icons on :invalid and :valid fields. Disable them with the $enable-validation-icons boolean Sass variable (defaults to true).
  • New: Added a new versions page to our docs
  • New: Tooltips/Popovers work with Shadow DOM
  • Updated: Redesigned the custom checkboxes and radios for more obvious states.
  • Updated: bootstrap-grid.css now includes our margin and padding utilities for full control of our grid system.
  • Updated: Changed auto columns (e.g., .col-auto) from max-width: none to max-width: 100% to prevent content from causing a column to overflow the parent.
  • Updated: Improved rendering of custom selects, ranges, file input, and more.

Checkout the full v4.2.0 ship list and GitHub project for the full details. Up next is v4.3 with some bugfixes, a few new modifier classes and variables, and some new utilities.

  • New: Added a new spinner loading component.
  • New: Added new toast component for displaying notifications.
  • New: Added a new iOS style switch (a modifier class to our custom checkboxes).
  • New: Added touch support in our carousel component.
  • New: Added .font-weight-lighter and .font-weight-bolder utilities.
  • New: Added .text-decoration-none utility class.
  • New: Added .modal-xl modifier class for our modals.
  • New: Added new negative margin utility classes (e.g., .mb-n3). These rad new classes not only allow you more control over your general spacing needs, but also allow you to create responsive grid gutters at each breakpoint.
  • New: Validated form fields now have feedback icons on :invalid and :valid fields. Disable them with the $enable-validation-icons boolean Sass variable (defaults to true).

  • Updated: Changed auto columns (e.g., .col-auto) from max-width: none to max-width: 100% to prevent content from causing a column to overflow the parent.
  • Updated: Improved rendering of custom selects, ranges, file input, and more.

Version 9 has reached end-of-support and will not receive future updates or fixes.

Please see VERSION_10_UPGRADE.md and perhaps SECURITY.md.

hljs.configure({

Release notes

Sourced from http-proxy's releases.

Long overdue maintenance

Due to some great contributions I'm happy to announce a new release of http-proxy containing numerous bug fixes, feature additions and documentation improvements. Thanks to all who contributed for their patience and willingness to contribute despite perceived stagnation in activity in the project. I welcome all contributions and those who are interested in getting more involved with the project. Below I will highlight the changes that landed in the latest version but you can find the full diff of the changes in nodejitsu/node-http-proxy#1251

  • Add option to rewrite path of set-cookie headers. @swillis12
  • Add option for overriding http METHOD when proxying request @AydinChavez
  • Feature: selfHandleResponse for taking responsibility in returning your own response when listening on the proxyRes event. @cpd0101 @guoxiangyang
  • Add followRedirects option @n30n0v
  • Document timeout option @jlaamanen
  • Fix documentation typos @carpsareokiguess
  • Document buffer option @jonhunter1977
  • Include websocket non-upgrade response instead of just closing the socket. Allows auth schemes to be possible with websocket proxying. @Tigge

  • Update types for compressionOptions to JSZipFileOptions and JSZipGeneratorOptions (see #722)
  • Add types for generateInternalStream (see #774)

  • Santize filenames when files are loaded with loadAsync, to avoid "zip slip" attacks. The original filename is available on each zip entry as unsafeOriginalName. See the documentation. Many thanks to McCaulay Hudson for reporting.

v3.7.1 2021-08-05

  • Fix build of dist files.
    • Note: this version ensures the changes from 3.7.0 are actually included in the dist files. Thanks to Evan W for reporting.

    • This change might break existing code if it uses prototype methods on the .files property of a zip object, for example zip.files.toString(). This approach is taken to prevent files in the zip overriding object methods that would exist on a normal object.
